principle: Your documents, handwriting and voice share one place.
platformContract: Reuse semantic tokens, original vector paths, state names and outcomes. Adapt navigation and input to each platform; do not copy browser pixels blindly.

outcomes: go to matching text or page
ask user to choose ambiguous page

interaction.focus: return to invoking control after dismissal where it remains present
interaction.motion: respond to user action; honor reduced motion
interaction.destructive: Trash is reversible; no permanent deletion control
interaction.network: do not claim sharing or cloud delivery without a backend receipt

integrationBoundary.pdf: current import/export retained; native editable PDF engine wiring is a later adapter
integrationBoundary.voice: browser recognition is real when supported; text rehearsal is explicitly labelled; never label injected input as microphone proof
